# American Association of Geographers (AAG)

> The AAG is the professional organization advancing geography and geospatial sciences through membership, conferences, community networks, and career development.

The American Association of Geographers (AAG) serves as the primary professional body for geographers in North America, fostering collaboration across academic, government, and private sectors. The organization emphasizes diversity, equity, and inclusion while providing comprehensive support for students, early-career professionals, and established scholars.

## Key Topics

- American Association of Geographers
- AAG Annual Meeting

## Organization & Mission

- [Home](https://www.aag.org): AAG homepage featuring membership, conferences, and community programs
- [About Us](https://www.aag.org/about-us): AAG mission, organizational goals, and strategic planning information
- [JEDI - Diversity, Equity & Inclusion](https://www.aag.org/jedi): AAG diversity, equity, inclusion strategic plan and leadership initiatives

## Membership & Benefits

- [Membership](https://www.aag.org/membership): AAG membership tiers, benefits, and professional networking resources
- [Community Groups](https://www.aag.org/community): AAG regional divisions and specialty/affinity groups for member networking
- [Awards & Grants](https://www.aag.org/grantsawards): AAG grants, awards, and recognition programs for geographers

## Events & Conferences

- [All Events](https://www.aag.org/all-events): AAG events directory including annual meeting, webinars, and networking

## Career & Education

- [Jobs & Careers](https://www.aag.org/jobs-careers): Geography career guidance, job sectors, and geospatial employment paths
- [Student Opportunities](https://www.aag.org/studentopportunities): AAG student internships, assistantships, and career development resources

## Professional Standards & Ethics

- [Ethics and AAG](https://www.aag.org/program/ethics-and-aag): AAG geoethics, research ethics, and professional ethics guidelines

## Support & Engagement

- [Make A Difference](https://www.aag.org/make-a-difference): AAG donation and fundraising page for charitable contributions

## Optional
